title: A Boat Safari on the Rufiji River
excerpt: On a boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere National Park you see hippos, crocodiles, elephants and birds from the water.
body:
A boat safari is one of the highlights of [Nyerere National Park](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/).

## What you see

- Hippos in large groups.
- Nile crocodiles basking on sandbanks.
- Elephants and buffaloes drinking at the water's edge.
- Birds: fish eagles, kingfishers, herons, storks and bee-eaters.

## How it works

Small motorboats take you along the river or through the lakes for two to three hours, often in the late afternoon, sometimes ending with a sundowner on a sandbank.

## Photography

Low angles from the water give unique photos.

## Safety

Boat guides know where hippos are and keep distance.
